title: Transcriptome analysis and artificial intelligence for predicting lymph node metastasis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
summary: A transcriptome-based model predicted lymph node metastasis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in a 36-patient cohort, with the data, comparison and evaluation reported in the full text. Interpretation stays with this small reported study; no broader clinical benefit follows.
